title: Energy Efficient Home Improvement Credit (IRC 25C)
headline: The 25C Home Improvement Credit Also Ended for 2026 Property
summary: Section 25C (windows, heat pumps, insulation, etc.) is a separate credit from solar’s 25D. Under OBBBA, 25C generally does not apply to property placed in service after December 31, 2025.

effective_dates.notes: Not allowed for property placed in service after Dec 31, 2025.

percent_or_amount: $0 for property placed in service after Dec 31, 2025.
homeowner_eligibility_notes: Do not confuse 25C (efficiency improvements) with 25D (clean energy). Both face 2025 cutoffs under OBBBA, with slightly different statutory wording.
claim_howto: Prior-year rules used Form 5695. Confirm with a tax advisor for any carryover or 2025 installs.

sections.heading: Why this shows up in solar research
sections.body: Sales conversations sometimes mix heat-pump HVAC, insulation, and solar incentives. In 2026, assume neither 25C nor 25D applies to newly completed residential work unless your tax advisor documents an exception.

faqs.question: If I add a heat pump with solar, do I get a federal credit?
faqs.answer: Generally not for property placed in service after Dec 31, 2025 under current OBBBA FAQs. Confirm with a tax advisor.

common_myths: Solar + heat pump still gets a federal efficiency rebate in 2026 (Usually false for new completes).
